intro: Journey to Astranaar is an introductory Alliance quest guiding newcomers arriving on the Kalimdor coast to the inland heart of Ashenvale. Directed by Fiora Longears at Auberdine, travelers make their way south and east along the forest roads to report to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar. It marks an adventurer's entry into the growing conflicts surrounding the night elves' ancestral forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... Go to Astranaar. I'm sure an eager member of the Alliance such as you can do some real good there. Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.
But don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here to offer your services to the Alliance, friend? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... Ashenvale Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
